title: Monitor Workers Free limits during failover
description: Workers Free was selected for the Cloudflare failover. Monitor requests/day against 100,000 and CPU per request against 10 ms; upgrade to Workers Paid if either approaches its limit.

title: Temporary Cloudflare Workers failover for medialternatives

notes: Cutover complete: production Workers Routes added after explicit approval on Workers Free. Apex and www verified serving the Worker with no Vercel outage response. Remaining: monitor Free limits and DO queue; roll back by deleting routes when Vercel is restored.

notes: Blocked on Vercel authentication/billing window reset; no route-level CPU data available from CLI here.
